kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قِشْطَة • (qišṭa) f
قِشْدَة • (qišda) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ق ش ط (q š ṭ) and a dialectal pronunciation thereof (also ك ش ط (k š ṭ)), denoting “to scrape”, “to strip off”, “to remove or take off”, “to skim”.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَشَطَ • (qašaṭa) I (non-past يَقْشِطُ (yaqšiṭu), verbal noun قَشْط (qašṭ))
g: to abrade, to scrape, to rub off, to skim
